<documents>
<document id="account-documents">
DocumentsˆforˆidentityˆverificationˆToˆverifyˆyourˆidentity,ˆweˆneedˆaˆphotoˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie,ˆplusˆaˆfewˆdetails.ˆ##ˆPhotoˆIDsˆweˆacceptˆ-ˆUSˆdriver'sˆlicenseˆorˆstateˆIDˆcardˆ-ˆUSˆpassportˆorˆpassportˆcardˆ-ˆPermanentˆresidentˆcardˆ-ˆForeignˆpassport,ˆtogetherˆwithˆanˆITINˆTheˆIDˆmustˆbeˆunexpired,ˆandˆallˆfourˆcornersˆmustˆbeˆvisibleˆinˆtheˆphoto.ˆ##ˆSelfieˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆtakeˆaˆshortˆselfieˆvideoˆtoˆmatchˆyourˆfaceˆtoˆtheˆID.ˆRemoveˆglassesˆandˆhats,ˆandˆuseˆgoodˆlight.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆlegalˆname,ˆdateˆofˆbirth,ˆresidentialˆaddressˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆYourˆnameˆmustˆmatchˆyourˆID.ˆ##ˆProofˆofˆaddressˆIfˆweˆcan'tˆconfirmˆyourˆaddressˆautomatically,ˆwe'llˆaskˆforˆaˆdocumentˆdatedˆwithinˆtheˆlastˆ90ˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆutilityˆbill,ˆleaseˆorˆbankˆstatement.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆdon'tˆacceptˆExpiredˆIDs,ˆphotocopies,ˆstudentˆIDs,ˆorˆscreenshotsˆofˆanˆID.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-ach-cutoff-v2">
ACHˆtransferˆcutoffˆtimesˆStandardˆtransfersˆtoˆandˆfromˆyourˆlinkedˆbankˆaccountsˆuseˆACH,ˆwhichˆonlyˆprocessesˆonˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimeˆTransfersˆyouˆsubmitˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆthatˆday.ˆTransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholiday,ˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆusuallyˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆTheˆotherˆbankˆdecidesˆwhenˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆmoneyˆavailable.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆonˆaˆFridayˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆit'sˆsentˆonˆMondayˆ(orˆTuesdayˆifˆMondayˆisˆaˆholiday).ˆ##ˆFasterˆoptionsˆ-ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆTallowbrookˆmembersˆarriveˆinˆseconds,ˆeveryˆday.ˆ-ˆDomesticˆwiresˆarriveˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆdayˆifˆsentˆbeforeˆtheˆwireˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆDailyˆandˆmonthlyˆACHˆlimitsˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆSeeˆtheˆtransferˆlimitsˆarticleˆforˆyourˆplan.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-activate">
ActivatingˆyourˆcardˆYourˆphysicalˆcardˆarrivesˆinactive.ˆYouˆneedˆtoˆactivateˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆbeforeˆyouˆcanˆuseˆitˆforˆpurchasesˆorˆatˆATMs.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆactivateˆ1.ˆOpenˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆCards.ˆ2.ˆTapˆActivateˆcard.ˆ3.ˆScanˆtheˆcardˆwithˆyourˆcamera,ˆorˆtypeˆtheˆlastˆ4ˆdigitsˆandˆtheˆexpiryˆdate.ˆ4.ˆSetˆyourˆPINˆwhenˆtheˆappˆasks.ˆActivationˆisˆinstant.ˆYourˆcardˆworksˆrightˆafter.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyourˆcardˆarrivesˆYouˆcanˆaddˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆorˆinˆaˆmobileˆwalletˆwhileˆyouˆwait.ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆnumber,ˆsoˆyouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆupdateˆitˆwhenˆtheˆphysicalˆcardˆshowsˆup.ˆ##ˆIfˆactivationˆfailsˆCheckˆthatˆyou'reˆactivatingˆtheˆnewestˆcard.ˆAnˆoldˆorˆreplacedˆcardˆcan'tˆbeˆactivated.ˆIfˆyourˆcardˆhasn'tˆarrivedˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆofˆorderingˆit,ˆmessageˆsupportˆsoˆweˆcanˆcancelˆitˆandˆsendˆanotherˆone.ˆReplacementˆcardsˆneedˆactivatingˆtoo.ˆForˆaˆdamagedˆcard,ˆyourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆnewˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
